title: Commit Wizard team configuration
description: Shared commit conventions read from .commit-wizard.json at the workspace root. Values here override the VS Code settings.

types.description: Commit types offered in the Type dropdown. Replaces the built-in list when non-empty.

description.description: Short explanation shown in the dropdown.

emoji.description: Gitmoji preselected when this type is picked. The user can still change it.

scopes.description: Shared scopes. Merged by name with scopes from the VS Code settings; this file wins on a clash.

emojis.description: When false, the Gitmoji dropdown is hidden and messages have no emoji prefix.

titleWarningLength.description: Short-description length at which the counter turns amber.

titleMaxLength.description: Short-description length at which the counter turns red.

issueTemplate.description: Markdown template for issues created from the "New Issue or Milestone" form. Placeholders: {{title}}, {{context}}, {{goal}}, {{scope}}, {{acceptanceCriteria}}, {{notes}}.

issuePattern.description: Regular expression applied to the branch name to detect the issue. The first capture group (or the whole match) is used.
